description: Score your own draft BEFORE you film or post it. Returns the draft alongside the rubric to hold it to — hook, clarity, payoff, specificity and fit, each scored 1-10 — and asks you for the three fixes that would move it most, one rewritten opening line and a tightened version. Free, and it makes no requests: the text is already yours, so the only thing missing was the standard. Use before filming, while the draft can still be changed.
